title: Scenario
description: Frontmatter contract for a multi-model scenario README. A scenario combines two or more model releases in one walkthrough, so it cannot live in a single capsule. Family-scoped scenarios live at models/<family>/multi-model-scenarios/<slug>/; cross-family scenarios live at models/multi-model-scenarios/<slug>/.

slug.description: Kebab-case folder slug — matches the scenario folder name.

scope.description: 'family' when every model belongs to one family (models/<family>/multi-model-scenarios/<slug>/); 'cross-family' when the scenario spans families (models/multi-model-scenarios/<slug>/).

family.description: Family slug. Required when scope is 'family'; omit for cross-family scenarios.

models.description: The releases this scenario combines. Two or more — a single-model walkthrough belongs in that model's capsule instead.

family.description: Family slug — must match a folder under models/.

model.description: Model slug — must match a capsule folder under models/<family>/.

role.description: What this model contributes to the scenario.

capabilities.description: Capability tags exercised by the scenario. Same enum as capsules — every tag needs a docs/primers/<slug>.md.

dependencies.description: Scenario-specific Python deps appended to requirements-dev.txt.

notebooks.description: Notebooks shipped with this scenario (paths relative to the scenario folder, at folder root). Each notebook covers 1–3 concepts; split rather than grow one.

references.description: Author-supplied references surfaced at the end of the scenario README.
